prompt: A calm, elegant face-yoga tutorial. The same woman, same studio, same clothes and lighting, filmed in a single continuous shot. It begins and ends in exactly the same pose so it loops seamlessly. Eyes stay OPEN and calm the whole clip. Only the ring fingertips move, tapping very lightly on the cheekbone below the eyes; the fingers never touch the eyes, eyelids or nose, never rub. Her ring fingers tap very lightly under the eyes, moving slowly from the inner corner outward, like tiny raindrops, then return to the inner corner. Her hands keep exactly five fingers each and stay softly on the skin, never sliding into the mouth or eyes, never pulling or distorting the skin. Her forehead stays smooth. Her face keeps its identity exactly. Natural blinking. Static locked camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts, framing unchanged, background unchanged.
negative_prompt: extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, deformed hands, hands inside mouth, fingers in eyes, skin pulled, face morphing, identity change, wrinkled forehead, raised eyebrows, exaggerated grimace, talking, camera movement, zoom, cuts, scene change, text, captions, logos, watermark, other people, jewelry change
